blocks.text: Managing your logistics inbox in Chrome

Your inbox is the heartbeat of your shipping operation. Keeping track of carrier updates and customer inquiries is constant. Use Chrome profiles to separate your personal browsing from your professional logistics tools. Go to the profile icon in the top right corner and select Add to create a dedicated workspace. This keeps your shipping bookmarks and extensions separate from your personal data.
Essential keyboard shortcuts for shipping coordinators

items: ⌘ + T: Open a new tab for a quick shipment lookup.
⌘ + L: Jump directly to the address bar to enter a tracking number.
⌘ + Option + Right Arrow: Switch to the next tab to compare carrier rates.
⌘ + Shift + T: Reopen a tab you accidentally closed during a busy shift.
⌘ + F: Find specific tracking numbers or order IDs on a long manifest page.

blocks.text: How Lazur assists in your browser

Lazur acts as your voice-controlled assistant on macOS. When you are looking at a complex shipping dashboard, hold ⌥ ⌘ to ask a question. Lazur sees your screen and provides answers out loud. If you need to find a specific button in a cluttered ERP interface, ask Lazur where it is. It will draw a circle around the element to help you spot it instantly.
Optimizing data entry for shipping documentation

Manual data entry into platforms like SAP or ShipStation is prone to errors. Use the dictation feature in Lazur to input shipment notes or customer address details. Hold the fn key to start dictation and speak your notes clearly. This keeps your hands on the keyboard and your eyes on the source document.

When a shipment gets stuck, you need to act fast. Keep your tracking tools organized by pinning your most used carrier websites. Right-click a tab and select Pin to keep it at the start of your tab bar. This ensures you can check status updates without searching through dozens of open tabs.
Advanced Chrome tips for logistics professionals

items: Use Tab Groups to categorize shipments by destination or carrier. Right-click any tab and select Add tab to new group.
Clear your site data regularly if a logistics portal starts acting slow. Use the settings menu to manage permissions for specific sites.
Install extensions only from trusted sources to keep your browser fast and secure.
Use the built-in password manager to keep your various portal logins safe and accessible.

blocks.text: Lazur remembers your previous requests throughout your session. If you ask about a tracking status and need to follow up later, you can ask about the previous shipment again. This context helps you maintain flow when managing multiple logistics threads at once. All your interaction history stays on your Mac for privacy.

faq.question: Can Lazur fill out my shipping forms automatically?
faq.answer: No. Lazur does not click buttons or edit files for you. It can help you find where to click or dictate text into fields.

faq.question: Does Chrome on Mac support all logistics software?
faq.answer: Most modern logistics platforms are web-based and work well in Chrome. Check your specific provider's system requirements to be sure.

faq.question: How do I speed up my Chrome browser?
faq.answer: Close unused tabs, remove unnecessary extensions, and clear your cache periodically to keep Chrome running smoothly.
